narrative.overview: IMC-Mail is a session sheet for a creator's mail: every thread is a numbered row ruled in hairlines, marked up like a producer's pen on a studio track sheet. It is flat. Surfaces are tonal steps of one cool graphite family, separated by 1px rules. Nothing glows, floats, or casts a shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tonal layering, hairline rules, no shadows or gradients.
One grotesque family, tabular numerals for data.
Accent color only for selection, primary actions, links, and the unread mark.
State carried by mark shape and weight, never hue alone.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: The blue accent appears on selection, the primary action, links, focus, and the unread mark, and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Flat Color Rule
rules.body: Every fill is one flat token. No gradients, glows, blurs, or shadows.

rules.name: The Shape Over Hue Rule
rules.body: A state is never signaled by color alone.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any column of numbers uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a layer needs separating, step its tone or draw a rule. Never add a shadow.

dos: Do take every color from a semantic token; never write a hex in a component.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 and control borders at 3:1 in all three themes.
Do carry state with a mark shape plus color.
Do use .num for any column of figures.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glows, or backdrop blur.
Don't use a colored stripe on the edge of a row or card.
Don't use an emoji or text glyph as an icon.
Don't let a state rely on color alone.
